needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk of at least 1.5m width along this side of the street.

needed.evidence: obstructions on the footway, partially blocking pedestrian movement

needed.evidence: uneven surface posing trip hazards on the footway

needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians waiting to cross on a wide road.
